evidence.V1: Front and three-quarter outlines read instantly as a hanging medal (bar + ribbon block + octagon token); silhouette is mirror-clean (A15 X/Y 0.0); top view is only a thin gold bar, which is inherent to a flat wearable, as with the shield badge.
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: big = octagon token and ribbon panel, medium = gold rim, top bar and suspension ring, small = central boss and cream stripe; the boss is a plain lighter-teal octagon, so the focal detail is the weakest tier.
evidence.V3: Reads as a stylised medal, but the ribbon is a plain rectangular slab (no taper, fold or V-cut) and the token is a straight octagon with a plain boss, so the shapes stay close to primitives rather than a confident exaggerated design.
evidence.V4: Gold rim, inner field step, boss and top bar carry even chamfers that catch the studio light, but the ribbon slab edges read razor-sharp with no chamfer highlight and the ring is a blocky low-segment loop, so the bevel treatment is inconsistent.
evidence.V5: Close-ups (token and ribbon, studio and flat) show no patches, pinches, seams or z-fighting; stripe sits flush on the ribbon cleanly, ring-into-rim overlap is intentional (cross-shell, 0.0825 penetration) and reads seated; A17/A18 pass with 0 self-intersections, 0 cap overlaps, 0 flipped faces.
evidence.V6: Gold accent + cream stripe + one hue (teal) in three values (dark ribbon, mid field, light boss); colourways crimson/shadow keep the same discipline.
evidence.V7: 484 tris against a small-class target of 600 (ceiling 1500), at or under target.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, kit gold, warm cream and a single hue in three values match the kit; the unchamfered ribbon slab and faceted ring differ from the kit's ~0.045-stud chamfer/smooth look seen on the anchors, a minor mismatch.
evidence.V9: Studio line is correct for a wearable: CanCollide off, CanQuery off, Massless when worn, CollisionFidelity Box, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic; A12 passes (note the origin field says 'hand/grip point' while the studio line says clasp-top hang point, a labelling inconsistency only).

artifacts: No surface artifacts visible in close-ups
Ribbon slab edges unchamfered (razor) compared with chamfered gold parts
Suspension ring is a low-segment, visibly faceted loop
Ribbon hangs behind the ring rather than visibly looping through it
gate_report origin label 'hand/grip point' disagrees with studio note 'clasp top (hang point)'
top_fixes: Chamfer the ribbon slab edges (~0.045 studs) so they catch light like the gold rim and bar
Give the ribbon a stylised shape (slight taper toward the ring, a fold or a V-notch/swallowtail) instead of a plain rectangle
Strengthen the central emblem (star, laurel or raised crest in gold/cream) so the small tier has a clear focal point with value contrast
Add segments or a rounder cross-section to the suspension ring and make the ribbon visibly wrap through it
Align the documented origin label with the clasp-top hang point
